_comment: Machine-readable schemas for the two structures this build defines: the verified results feed
(the settlement stream that backtests and ROI consume) and the demotion gate (the rule that sends
a live strategy back to paper). The demotion gate's parameters are this build's own design; they
mirror the promotion gates already published so that the same evidence that blocks a strategy from
going live is what retires a live strategy.

results_feed.name: verified results feed
results_feed.purpose: The settlement stream that makes backtests and ROI computable at all. One row per settled bet.

columns.note: the strategy that produced the bet
the American-odds price recorded when the bet was taken
the flat 1-unit stake; no staking plan is evaluated
stake plus profit/loss at the recorded price
the committed file or official publisher the row came from

results_feed.settlement_rule: Win/loss/push is recorded from the final score at the recorded price. A push returns the stake; a loss loses the stake; a win returns the stake plus the profit implied by the American-odds price. Settlement mechanics are cited to the licensed-operator market rules.
results_feed.rule: A value not confirmable from an official source, or a price with no recorded source, is left blank and flagged. The feed is never used to impute a missing price.

demotion_gate.name: demotion gate
demotion_gate.purpose: Sends a live strategy back to paper when its trailing evidence no longer supports live status.
demotion_gate.parameters_source: This build's own design; mirrors the repository's published promotion gates.

triggers.label: Sample size below the live floor
ROI confidence-interval lower bound not positive

demotion_gate.rule: A strategy is LIVE only if it clears every trigger. The first trigger that fires (in the fixed order N, Q, CI, S, G) is the recorded reason; every trigger that fires is listed. A strategy that fires any trigger is DEMOTED, i.e. returned to paper, and is not ranked for rewards.
